Tests of time-varying effects

Source: R/temporal.R
temporal_tests.Rd

Wald tests of whether the effect of each tv() term changes over time: a joint test that the effects are equal in all periods, and a test of each change between adjacent periods. The tests concern the period effects, so they are the same for every basis.

Usage

temporal_tests(object, term = NULL, vcov = NULL, adjust = "none", ...)

Arguments

object

a fitted model with tv() terms.

term

optional names of the varying variables ("(Intercept)" for tv(1, ...)); all by default.

vcov

optional covariance matrix of the coefficients, such as a cluster-robust one; vcov(object) by default.

adjust

p-value adjustment for the adjacent-period tests (see stats::p.adjust()); none by default.

...

unused.

Value

A data frame with columns part, term, test ("all equal" or the pair of periods), estimate (the change, for adjacent periods), std.error, statistic (\(\chi^2\) for the joint test, \(z\) otherwise), df and p.value.

See also

tv(), temporal_effects()
